text: 2. #2954 fail() TELEMETRY INTACT on BOTH fail() calls in the block (and in fact on all fail() calls in the verification gate): each passes the two new params `&event_id` and `Some(&nutzap)` in the correct positions, and `fail()` itself records `WalletConsumedInput` (event_id + nutzap-derived mint/amount) before transitioning to Failed. The privkey `fail(...NO_CASHU_WALLET...)` and the DLEQ `fail(...INVALID_NUTZAP...)` both carry both params correctly.
